payload.task_text:
You are a company event coordinator responsible for planning a team building trip from Beijing to Shanghai for a group of 15 employees on March 10, 2026. Your task is to coordinate the entire trip including rail travel, catered team dinner, documentation, and calendar scheduling.

Begin by checking today's date and then looking up the station codes for Beijing and Shanghai. Query the available high-speed rail services departing from Beijing South Station to Shanghai Hongqiao Station on March 10, 2026. From the results, select the train with the earliest departure time that still allows the team to arrive in Shanghai in time for afternoon activities. Retrieve the full route stop information for the selected train to confirm intermediate stations. Then look up the available seat classes and prices for the selected train, noting the options for second class, first class, and business class seats.

Next, use the recipe system to plan the team dinner menu. Search for appetizer or starter recipes and collect at least five options suitable for a group setting. Then search for main course recipes, preferably dishes that represent popular Chinese home cooking, and collect at least five options. Finally search for dessert or soup recipes and collect at least three options. From these results, select a final dinner menu consisting of two appetizers, three main course dishes, and one dessert or soup. For each selected dish, retrieve the full recipe details including ingredient list, cooking time, and serving yield.

Create an Excel workbook named Team_Trip_Plan.xlsx. Add a sheet named Travel with columns Train_No, Direction, Departure, Arrival, Duration_Min, Seat_Class, Per_Person_CNY, and Total_Budget_CNY. Fill in the row for the selected train with all travel details including the total budget computed as per-person ticket price multiplied by 15 team members. The train number may be written as "G11" or "G11次" (the Chinese '次' suffix is optional). The Direction column should state the route from Beijing to Shanghai in any clear notation (e.g., "Beijing-Shanghai", "Beijing->Shanghai", or "Beijing to Shanghai"). Departure and Arrival times may be written in 24-hour format (e.g., 07:00) or 12-hour format with AM/PM (e.g., 7:00 AM). Duration_Min may be written either as a number of minutes (e.g., 331) or as an HH:MM duration (e.g., 05:31). Total_Budget_CNY may be written either as the computed number (e.g., 5235) or as an Excel formula that multiplies the per-person price by 15. Add a second sheet named Menu with columns Course_Type, Dish_Name, Cook_Time_Min, Servings_Yield, Key_Ingredients, and Notes. Add one row per selected dish covering the full menu of six dishes. For each dish, Servings_Yield should record the servings after scaling the recipe up for the full 15-person team (i.e., 15). Add a third sheet named Timeline with columns Time, Activity, Location, Responsible_Person, and Notes. Populate this sheet with at least six activity entries covering departure from Beijing station, boarding the train, arrival at Shanghai Hongqiao, hotel check-in, the start of the team dinner, and the post-dinner team building activities. Times may be written in 24-hour format (e.g., 06:30, 18:00) or 12-hour format with AM/PM (e.g., 6:30 AM, 6:00 PM); both are accepted.

Create a page in the team knowledge base titled something that references the team building trip and the March 10 date. Add content to this page that describes the trip overview, the travel plan, and the dinner agenda as structured text blocks.

Schedule three events on the shared calendar. The first event should be titled something like Team Trip Departure and should cover the morning window from 06:30 to 07:30 on March 10, 2026, representing the time needed to get to the station. The second event should cover the arrival and hotel check-in window from 12:30 to 14:00 on March 10, 2026. The third event should mark the Team Dinner from 18:00 to 20:00 on March 10, 2026.

Finally, send an email to events@company.com summarizing the trip plan and mentioning the knowledge base page that was created and the Excel workbook with all planning details.

The configuration file trip_config.json in your workspace contains key parameters including the team size of 15, the travel date, departure and destination cities, the preferred seat class of second class, the dinner time of 18:00, and a per-person budget reference of 800 CNY. The file event_planning_guide.md explains how to compute total travel budget, how to scale recipes for a large group of 15, what to include in each Excel sheet, and how to format the timeline in 30-minute increments.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, follow this exact orchestration plan. A wave must finish and return all stated handoffs before the next wave begins. Within a wave, dispatch exactly one sub-agent for each numbered sub-task and run those sub-agents concurrently.

Before Wave 1, the main agent must read trip_config.json and event_planning_guide.md in read-only mode, preserve the task's explicit 2026-03-10, 15-person, second-class, menu, workbook, page, calendar, and recipient contract, and check current date only through the granted rail tool. The three calendar targets are fixed and independent of source discovery, so the main agent must search for all three and, in the same orchestration response that launches Wave 1, create at most the missing `Team Trip Departure` event from 06:30 to 07:30, `Arrival and Hotel Check-in` event from 12:30 to 14:00, and `Team Dinner` event from 18:00 to 20:00 on 2026-03-10 in Asia/Shanghai, with no invented attendees. Retain all event IDs, never retry an ambiguous create, and perform their read-backs without delaying a ready source or writer wave. Both source branches below use only read-only rail and HowToCook operations and return compact structured handoffs.

1. Wave 1 — dispatch exactly 2 sub-agents in parallel, one for each numbered sub-task:

   1. explore 0 (web-domain-researcher 0): Use one explore sub-agent to own the rail evidence branch. Call the rail tools in their required sequence: get the current date, resolve the specific Beijing South and Shanghai Hongqiao station codes, query every eligible high-speed service for 2026-03-10 without an artificial result limit, select the earliest departure that can arrive before the afternoon activities, and use the returned actual train_no—not its display code—to retrieve the complete ordered route. Return the selected service and compact controls, preserving departure, arrival, duration, every returned second-, first-, and business-class price/availability field, the second-class total for 15, query/result counts, identifiers, and validation status. Do not write files, create deliverables, or alter rail state.
   2. explore 1 (web-domain-researcher 1): Use one explore sub-agent to own the dinner evidence branch. Use the granted HowToCook catalog read-only; exhaust the available catalog/category results, gather at least five genuine starter options, five genuine Chinese home-style main options, and three genuine dessert-or-soup options, then select exactly two starters, three mains, and one dessert or soup. Retrieve each selected recipe's full details by its returned identifier/name and derive scaled quantities or notes for 15 without claiming that the tool natively supports 15 when its people-count tools cap at 10. Return a compact six-dish record with base yield, ingredients, cooking time, candidate/selected counts, selected names, scale basis, and validation status. Do not write files or create final deliverables.

After Wave 1, the main agent must reconcile both structured handoffs with the visible configuration and guide, reject invented train or recipe fields, and freeze one six-dish menu and one selected-train record for Wave 2.

2. Wave 2 — dispatch exactly 2 sub-agents in parallel, one for each numbered sub-task:

   1. coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Use one coder sub-agent to own Team_Trip_Plan.xlsx exclusively. Consume the frozen train/menu evidence, create the workbook exactly once with Travel, Menu, and Timeline, and write the exact required headers and literal values or the explicitly permitted travel-budget formula. Keep the six menu rows scaled to a serving yield of 15 and build a chronological timeline with at least six required activities. Read back every sheet and return the workbook path, sheet order, row counts, key totals, and header/value validation. Do not create or modify Notion, calendar, or email state.
   2. coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 0): Use one coder sub-agent to own only the dynamic Notion page. Search first for an existing matching trip page, create exactly one substantive page if absent, use the frozen train and dish names in its content, then read it back and return the page ID, exact title/content controls, and verification. Do not write the workbook, calendar, or email.

After Wave 2, the main agent must read back all retained event IDs and reconcile the workbook, page, and three events against the original task. It must then search sent mail for the exact recipient and trip context and send at most one missing email to events@company.com that names the verified page and Team_Trip_Plan.xlsx. It must perform final artifact and external-state checks before completion.

You are helping plan rail travel. Your ONLY goal: retrieve the full route stop list (经停站) for high-speed train "G11" departing Beijing South (北京南) on 2026-03-10 and arriving Shanghai Hongqiao (上海虹桥), using the 12306 MCP rail tools available to you.

WHAT I ALREADY KNOW (verified, do not re-verify unless useful):
- Today's date returned by `mcp__rail_12306__get-current-date` is 2026-09-02.
- `mcp__rail_12306__get-station-code-by-names` with stationNames "北京南|上海虹桥" returns: 北京南 -> VNP, 上海虹桥 -> SHH. Shanghai city also has 上海 -> AOH.
- `mcp__rail_12306__get-tickets` for date=2026-03-10, fromStation=VNP, toStation=SHH returns exactly two trains:
  * G11, train_no "G11_260310_1", 北京南 -> 上海虹桥, 07:00 -> 12:31, 05:31
  * G1, train_no "G1_260310_1", 北京南 -> 上海虹桥, 09:00 -> 13:28, 04:28
- `mcp__rail_12306__get-train-route-stations` with trainNo="G1_260310_1", fromStationTelecode="VNP", toStationTelecode="SHH", departDate="2026-03-10" WORKS and returns: 北京南 (stop 1, arrive "--"), 南京南 (stop 2, arrive 11:38, stopover 2 min), 上海虹桥 (stop 3, arrive 13:28).
- The SAME call with trainNo="G11_260310_1" returns "未查询到相关车次信息" (no data found). These variants for G11 also all failed: "G11", "G11次", "G11次_260310_1", "G11_260310", "G11_260310_2", "G11_260310_01", "G011_260310_1", "24000000G110", "240000G11000", and combos of telecodes (VNP->AOH, BJP->SHH). Querying tickets for other dates (2026-09-03) or city-level codes (BJP->AOH) returns no trains at all, so 2026-03-10 VNP->SHH is the only dataset.

YOUR JOB: systematically hunt for a working parameter combination that returns G11's route stops. Things worth trying (in whatever order seems smartest): other plausible train_no spellings/encodings for G11; other departDate values paired with those; other fromStationTelecode/toStationTelecode values (e.g., intermediate stations along the Beijing-Shanghai corridor such as 南京南 "NJH", 济南西 "JGK", 徐州东, 蚌埠南, 苏州北, 无锡东, 上海 "AOH", 北京 "BJP", 北京丰台); `mcp__rail_12306__get-station-by-telecode` to check telecodes; `mcp__rail_12306__get-interline-tickets` for extra clues. Be persistent and creative but stay within the rail tools — do NOT read any files or access anything outside the rail MCP tools.

DELIVERABLE (report back in your final message):
1. Either the exact successful parameter combination(s) AND the full returned stop list for G11 (station names, station numbers, arrive times, stopover minutes), or a clear statement that no combination you tried returns G11's route (list the variants you tried).
2. Any other useful facts you discovered (e.g., whether other trains' routes are retrievable).
Do not attempt any writes. This is read-only investigation.
Find G11 route station data

Create a page in the company team knowledge base (Notion) documenting a team building trip. You have Notion write tools available (mcp__notion__API-post-page, mcp__notion__API-patch-block-children, mcp__notion__API-post-search, mcp__notion__API-retrieve-a-page, mcp__notion__API-get-block-children).

CONTEXT / WHERE TO CREATE IT
- The connected Notion workspace currently contains only one page, id "page-sprint12-154af770" (parent of the "Sprint Tasks" database). Treat that page as the team knowledge base root.
- Create the new page as a CHILD of that page: parent = {"type": "page_id", "page_id": "page-sprint12-154af770"}.
- If that parent is rejected, retry with parent = {"type": "workspace", "workspace": true}.
- Do not touch, edit or archive any other page. Do not send email, do not create calendar events.

PAGE TITLE (must be used exactly): Team Building Trip to Shanghai – March 10, 2026

PAGE CONTENT — create these blocks in this exact order. Use block type "heading_1" for the three section headings (payload key "heading_1" with "rich_text"), "paragraph" for prose, and "bulleted_list_item" for bullet lines. Each rich_text item is {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "<text>"}}.

1. heading_1: Trip Overview
2. paragraph: One-day team building trip for 15 employees travelling together from Beijing to Shanghai on Tuesday, March 10, 2026. The team rides high-speed rail from Beijing South to Shanghai Hongqiao, checks into the hotel near the station, holds a catered Chinese home-style team dinner at 18:00, and closes the day with post-dinner team building activities.
3. paragraph: Team size: 15 people | Travel date: 2026-03-10 | Route: Beijing South -> Shanghai Hongqiao | Preferred seat class: Second Class (二等座) | Budget reference: 800 CNY per person
4. heading_1: Travel Plan
5. paragraph: Train G11 (G11次) is the earliest high-speed departure from Beijing South that still gets the team to Shanghai in time for the afternoon programme. It departs Beijing South Railway Station at 07:00 and arrives at Shanghai Hongqiao Station at 12:31, a journey of 5 hours 31 minutes (331 minutes).
6. bulleted_list_item: Train: G11 | Direction: Beijing South (VNP) -> Shanghai Hongqiao (SHH)
7. bulleted_list_item: Departure: 07:00 from Beijing South | Arrival: 12:31 at Shanghai Hongqiao
8. bulleted_list_item: Duration: 5 h 31 min (331 minutes)
9. bulleted_list_item: Seats booked: Second Class (二等座), 15 tickets
10. bulleted_list_item: Seat classes available on G11: Business Class (商务座) 1748.5 CNY - sold out; First Class (一等座) 553 CNY - available; Second Class (二等座) 349 CNY - available
11. bulleted_list_item: Per-person ticket price: 349 CNY (Second Class) | Total travel budget: 349 x 15 = 5,235 CNY
12. paragraph: Note: the rail booking system returned no intermediate-stop data for G11 on this date, so the timetable lists it as a direct Beijing South -> Shanghai Hongqiao run.
13. heading_1: Dinner Agenda (18:00 - 20:00)
14. paragraph: Catered Chinese home-style menu for 15 people. Every recipe is a base serving of 1 scaled up x15 for the full team.
15. bulleted_list_item: Appetizer - 凉拌黄瓜 (smashed cucumber salad): cucumber, garlic, vinegar, light soy sauce, sesame oil, oyster sauce; about 20 minutes; serves 15
16. bulleted_list_item: Appetizer - 话梅煮毛豆 (plum-boiled edamame): edamame, preserved plums, salt; about 45 minutes; serves 15
17. bulleted_list_item: Main - 宫保鸡丁 (Kung Pao chicken): chicken thigh, roasted peanuts, dried chilli, Sichuan peppercorn, scallion; about 75 minutes including 1 hour marinating; serves 15
18. bulleted_list_item: Main - 鱼香肉丝 (yu-xiang shredded pork): pork tenderloin, carrot, green pepper, wood ear mushroom, doubanjiang; about 45 minutes; serves 15
19. bulleted_list_item: Main - 可乐鸡翅 (cola chicken wings): chicken wings, cola, soy sauce, ginger; about 40 minutes; serves 15
20. bulleted_list_item: Dessert - 银耳莲子粥 (snow fungus and lotus seed sweet soup): white fungus, lotus seeds, red dates, goji berries, rock sugar; about 90 minutes; serves 15
21. heading_1: Day Timeline
22. bulleted_list_item: 06:30 - Team assembly at the Beijing office and departure for Beijing South Railway Station (60-minute window 06:30-07:30)
23. bulleted_list_item: 07:00 - Security check, boarding of train G11 and departure from Beijing South
24. bulleted_list_item: 12:31 - Arrival at Shanghai Hongqiao Station and head count
25. bulleted_list_item: 13:00 - Transfer to the hotel and hotel check-in (check-in window 12:30-14:00)
26. bulleted_list_item: 14:00 - Afternoon activities: Bund walk and team photo
27. bulleted_list_item: 17:30 - Pre-dinner gathering and transfer to the restaurant
28. bulleted_list_item: 18:00 - Team dinner starts (six-dish catered menu)
29. bulleted_list_item: 20:00 - Post-dinner team building: quiz, awards and team retrospective
30. bulleted_list_item: 22:00 - Return to the hotel and day wrap-up
31. heading_1: Where to Find the Details
32. paragraph: Full planning details are in the Excel workbook Team_Trip_Plan.xlsx (sheets: Travel, Menu, Timeline). The shared calendar holds three events on March 10, 2026: Team Trip Departure (06:30-07:30), Team Trip Arrival & Hotel Check-in (12:30-14:00) and Team Dinner (18:00-20:00).

DELIVERABLE (report in your final message): the created page id and URL, the page title you used, which parent you used, and a confirmation that every block was written (state the block count). If creation fails, report the exact error text.
Create Notion trip page

Schedule three events on the shared company Google Calendar for a team building trip. You have the calendar write tools mcp__google_calendar__create_event, mcp__google_calendar__list_events and mcp__google_calendar__get_event.

Create exactly these three events, all on March 10, 2026, in the Asia/Shanghai time zone (use dateTime strings with +08:00 offset, e.g. "2026-03-10T06:30:00+08:00", and set timeZone "Asia/Shanghai"):

1. Title: "Team Trip Departure"
   Start 2026-03-10 06:30, End 2026-03-10 07:30 (Asia/Shanghai)
   Location: Beijing office -> Beijing South Railway Station
   Description: Morning window to get 15 team members from the office to Beijing South Railway Station for high-speed train G11, which departs at 07:00 for Shanghai Hongqiao. Second Class seats, 15 tickets.

2. Title: "Team Trip Arrival & Hotel Check-in"
   Start 2026-03-10 12:30, End 2026-03-10 14:00 (Asia/Shanghai)
   Location: Shanghai Hongqiao Station -> hotel
   Description: Train G11 arrives at Shanghai Hongqiao at 12:31. Transfer to the hotel and complete check-in for 15 guests within the 12:30-14:00 window, followed by afternoon team activities.

3. Title: "Team Dinner"
   Start 2026-03-10 18:00, End 2026-03-10 20:00 (Asia/Shanghai)
   Location: Restaurant private dining room, Shanghai
   Description: Catered team dinner for 15 people. Menu: appetizers 凉拌黄瓜 and 话梅煮毛豆; mains 宫保鸡丁, 鱼香肉丝 and 可乐鸡翅; dessert 银耳莲子粥. Recipes scaled x15 for the full team.

Do not create, modify or delete any other calendar events. Do not send emails and do not write to Notion.

DELIVERABLE (report in your final message): the event id, title, start and end time of each of the three created events, plus a short confirmation that all three were created successfully (or the exact error text if any failed).
Schedule 3 trip calendar events
